reason: I'm already burning maybe $25-30 a month on plastic bottles when I forget mine, and if a creator I actually trust is using it on camera I'll use the code and try the 3-pack plan. Around $65 up front stings a bit, but it pays for itself in a couple of months.
objection: Never heard of Claro, so I'm worried it's a cheap knockoff bottle with a rebranded filter, and that the subscription is the real catch.
would_change_my_mind: If the creator only showed it once as a paid ad and never actually used it again, or reviews said the filter makes the water taste off or the bottle leaks, I'd skip it.
